note: Owner footage lane (owner, 20 Nov 2026: 'tum upload kardo, daily upload me daal do'; scripts/owner-footage.mjs). REAL darshan videos the owner recorded himself at a Khatu Shyam ji pandal, edited into muted 1080x1920 reels with the channel logo. Each reel gets one licence-checked library track (music/library, cc-* = original arrangements of CC0 human recordings: no AI, no third-party song) at -14 LUFS with fades, and is hosted as a GitHub release asset (not in git history). One reel a day as an EXTRA Short (upload-guard slot 'owner', its own cap of 1, outside the 3 Shorts), public at `at` IST on YouTube, Facebook (fb.mjs spacing) and Instagram (queued, flushed by the next trigger). Order = the clips array; skipped clips: automation/owner-footage-skip.txt. The muted originals stay in the owner's Downloads folder.
at_note: 07:15 IST from 21 Nov 2026 (was 09:30; competitor decode automation/competitor-decode-2026-11.md: real-darshan Shorts win at aarti time 05:00-07:30, 08-10 h is the weakest upload hour, 0.89x).
